video: Anime chat sticker loop, flat solid green background, locked camera, no zoom. She jolts with anger, fists shake, she glares, her cheeks puff up round with anger, then she shouts one short 'hmph' and turns her face slightly away. The small red anger mark on her hair blinks (it stays small, on her hair). Small solid white steam puffs pop from the top of her head. The spirit otter shakes its tiny fists too. When her cheeks puff, it is correct anime form: both cheeks round outward like a hamster and the face outline bulges a little at the cheeks, lips pressed into a small pout; the mouth stays small, in its normal place and visible; never a blob or balloon in front of the mouth. Hair, water scarf and sheer sleeves follow the motion with soft inertia and settle. Keep her face, outfit and accessories exactly unchanged. She returns to the exact starting pose at the end. The camera stays locked on the same upper-body framing as the first frame for the whole clip: never zoom out, never pull back, never reveal her legs. Effects stay small and close to her, never filling the background. No green-colored effects or light. Lively expressive anime timing, background stays flat green, no text.
